nodes.label: Progress Tracker
nodes.description: Full-stack project monitoring and evaluation platform with work plans, progress, challenges, finances, spreadsheet imports, reports and presentation mode.

nodes.label: Vite React frontend
nodes.description: Frontend entry points are main.tsx, App.tsx, api.ts and supabase.ts; includes invitation and presentation routes.

nodes.label: Express TypeScript backend
nodes.description: REST API with project-scoped members, activities, updates, challenges, financial entries, reports, imports and notifications.

nodes.label: Supabase authentication and persistence
nodes.description: Provides authentication, membership, access control, storage, notifications and invitation workflows.

nodes.label: Scheduled overdue reminders
nodes.description: GitHub Actions invokes send-overdue-reminders using X-Cron-Secret; managers configure frequency and UTC-based schedules.

nodes.label: Local demo mode
nodes.description: Frontend uses demo mode if Supabase URL and anon key are not configured.

nodes.label: Account loading integration
nodes.source_location: StackBlitz development: signed in but account does not load
nodes.rationale: Successful Supabase sign-in does not prove Express reachability; the frontend must retrieve JSON account and memberships from /api/users/me.
